I got it just about right on my first try with the magnet but after a couple more times of using it, I find it super simple to get the design I want and I am not a nail tech!

reviews.t: very pretty assortment of cat eye colors
reviews.x: Love the colors and the value.  These are thick and very pretty and they have an amazing effect.  I tested all the colors and all are vibrant and produce the cat eye effect easily with the provided magnet.  Lots of fun to use these.
The colors are so light & sheer that even with the black base coat & 3 layers of color you can barely see any cat eye design. I would definitely NOT recommend this product!  Very disappointed!

The magnets that came with it do not make the designs shown in the videos or pictures. I think it is the polish itself. Very sticky and thick, will not spread as other gel polishes do. claims.text: Many reviewers find the colors vibrant and the cat eye effect easy to achieve with the included magnet.
Several reviewers report the polish is sheer or not vibrant, requiring a dark base coat and multiple coats to see any effect.
Some reviewers say the magnet is weak or the polish barely responds to it.
A few reviewers note the bottles are small and you don't get much product.
Some reviewers received damaged or opened bottles, or product that looked different from the picture.
